macro.name: Pacific Northwest Corridor
macro.summary: High truck/SUV density, constant rain, moss and road grime. Ideal proving ground for coatings and maintenance plans.
macro.notes: Use this macro band to judge expansion pacing from Eugene northward. Watch intercity logistics and seasonal weather swings.
macro.vectors: Macro · Wet Climate · High SUV Density
